concepts.title: FAFNIR
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the supplied existing game creature illustration into a NEW wide two-panel creature concept comparison board for Pantheon Realms. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its rich painterly fantasy game rendering, sculpted dimensional scales, crisp readable edges, warm highlights, cool shadows and natural materials. Replace the aquatic monster completely with the specified dragon species. This is full-body creature design for a classic Heroes of Might and Magic III-inspired strategy game, not a cinematic close-up or cartoon. Landscape approximately 3:2 canvas, equal left/right panels, restrained dark slate-green painted studio backdrop and understated antique-gold serif captions. Each panel has exactly ONE creature, full body fully visible including all wings, tail, claws, horns. Both creatures face RIGHT in consistent 3/4 side view, same camera, similar pose, same baseline and light. Generous margins, no overlap between creatures or clipping. Ground-contact shadows, a few appropriate pebbles only, no scenic background, no hex grid, no UI stats. Base LEFT and upgrade RIGHT. The upgrade is the same species and recognizable anatomy with an evolved silhouette and material detail, NOT just a palette swap. Keep effects restrained so anatomy can be judged. Detailed polished illustration, convincing anatomical connections, useful silhouette at small game size. Do not include any creature from the reference.
Species: Fafnir-inspired HOARD DRAGON, a heavy WINGLESS quadrupedal dragon, broad crocodilian chest and powerful short four legs, long thick tapering tail, a single long predatory horned head, armored brow, layered bronze and charcoal scales, gold coins trapped sparingly between hide plates, intelligent amber eyes, small green venom droplets at jaws. NO wings, NO wing stubs, NO extra heads. Base: weathered bronze scales, two swept-back horns, bulky low crouch, sparse gold inclusions, visibly dangerous and mature, not a baby. Upgrade: CURSED HOARD DRAGON, still wingless and four-legged, more massive muscular neck and shoulder shell, sculptural layered blackened-bronze natural armor with hammered-gold mineral seams, heavier backward-curving crown horns and enlarged cheek spikes, larger gold deposits embedded organically in plates, subtle emerald venom glands at jaw and tiny poison wisps near mouth. Avoid mechanical armor or human jewelry. Upgrade should look ancient, greedy and almost immovable. Upper title "FAFNIR". Under left creature exact caption "HOARD DRAGON" and smaller "Base". Under right creature "CURSED HOARD DRAGON" and smaller "Upgrade".

Species: Yinglong-inspired Chinese WINGED rain dragon. A long elegant continuous serpentine body, one refined antlered head with long flowing whiskers and a fine mane, four small clawed legs spaced naturally along torso, one pair of broad graceful pale membrane wings attached just behind shoulders; clearly winged Chinese dragon, NOT a European bulky dragon, NOT a snake with detached limbs. Pose is a low floating S-curve, head right, tail curving back left, all anatomy fits its own panel. Base RAIN DRAGON: jade-green small overlapping scales, warm ivory ventral plates, modest natural antlers, teal mane, graceful pale turquoise wing membranes with gold-ivory struts, a small ribbon of mist trailing beneath body. Upgrade CELESTIAL RAIN DRAGON: same body plan and pose but richer pearl-white and deep-jade scales with fine gold edging, larger branching ivory antlers, luxurious long silver-teal mane and whiskers, wider elegantly scalloped pearlescent wings, richer fin fringe along tail, THREE small floating clear water pearls tracing the body's curve and delicate restrained rain strands. Mature serene divine intelligence and imposing strength, not cute. No clothing, human armor, extra heads, giant glow halos or cloud obscuring the body. Upper title "YINGLONG". Below left "RAIN DRAGON" and smaller "Base". Below right "CELESTIAL RAIN DRAGON" and smaller "Upgrade".
